{{Quote|Not fair! This is why Rouggle failed the trials!|Thame Cerulian comments on a version of the Trial of Skill in ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="TJP" />}}
'''Rouggle''' was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the last [[Time/Legends|century]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Rouggle [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and reached the rank of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], but did not pass the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]]. When taking the Trial of Skill&mdash;a test of a prospective [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight's]] ability to retain self-discipline while distracted&mdash;floor tiles were shifted under Rouggle's feet during a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] challenge, causing the Padawan to fail. Rouggle's friend, [[Thame Cerulian]], commented on the particular version of the Trial of Skill in his copy of ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', believing Rouggle's failure to have been unfair.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rouggle was first mentioned in [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], a [[2010]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TJP" />
